title: Misquoting Manmohan Singh's Resource Speech
description: During a 2024 election rally in Banswara, Rajasthan, Modi claimed that former PM Manmohan Singh stated Muslims have the 'first claim' on the country's resources. Fact-checkers noted that Singh's actual 2006 speech referred collectively to all marginalized and priority sectors, including SC/STs, OBCs, women, children, and minorities.

title: Attributing a Parody Quote to Omar Abdullah
description: In a 2020 speech to the Lok Sabha, Modi targeted former Jammu & Kashmir CM Omar Abdullah by quoting him as saying the abrogation of Article 370 would cause an earthquake that splits Kashmir from India. An Alt News investigation revealed that the quote originated from a satirical article on the spoof website 'Faking News'.

title: Claim Regarding Atal Bihari Vajpayee and the First Metro
description: In December 2017, Modi stated that Atal Bihari Vajpayee became the first-ever passenger of the country's metro system on December 24, 2002. However, India's first metro line was inaugurated in Kolkata in 1984 under the tenure of Indira Gandhi, decades before the Delhi Metro opened.

title: Claim of Launching the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) Scheme
description: Modi claimed in a 2017 public address that his government had conceptualized and launched the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) initiative. Official records verify that the DBT scheme was actually launched by the previous UPA government on January 1, 2013.

title: Claim of Uniform 100% Open Defecation Free (ODF) Status
description: During an address to the Indian diaspora in Munich, Germany, Modi asserted that every village in India was completely open defecation free. Independent data from the National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5) contradicted this, reporting that open defecation practices remained prevalent in several rural parts of the country.

title: Misquoting Rahul Gandhi on 'Coconut Juice'
description: In an election rally speech, Modi ridiculed Congress leader Rahul Gandhi by claiming Gandhi had spoken about extracting 'juice from coconuts' and exporting it to London. Fact-checks of the original speech footage showed Gandhi had actually referred to 'pineapple juice' and making potato chips.

title: Claim of 100% Household LPG Gas Connectivity Coverage
description: Modi stated in an international address that over 99% of the Indian population had active gas connections. However, demographic surveys like the NFHS-5 noted that approximately 41% of rural households still relied on solid fuels for cooking rather than LPG.

title: Allegations Linking Pakistan to the Gujarat Assembly Elections
description: During a 2017 election rally in Gujarat, Modi claimed that a secret meeting had taken place at Congress leader Mani Shankar Aiyar’s house featuring Pakistani officials trying to influence the state elections. Participants of the meeting, including senior Indian diplomats and former PM Manmohan Singh, confirmed it was a routine dinner discussing bilateral relations.

title: Claim That Weather-Based Crop Insurance Was New
description: Modi claimed in a public forum that his administration had introduced a completely new weather-based crop insurance policy for farmers. Records indicate that the Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (WBCIS) had been piloted and operational since 2003.

title: Claim of Disproportionate Power Supply During Diwali vs. Eid
description: During a 2017 Uttar Pradesh assembly election rally, Modi asserted that previous state governments supplied more electricity during Eid than during Diwali. Fact-checks analyzing official power grid data from the Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation showed that the power supply was actually higher during Diwali.

title: Claim Linking Kanpur Train Derailment to Cross-Border Sabotage
description: In an election speech in 2017, Modi stated that the tragic Kanpur train derailment was a conspiracy masterminded by handlers sitting across the border in Pakistan. Subsequent investigations by the National Investigation Agency (NIA) and local police failed to find any evidence supporting a cross-border sabotage theory, attributing it to track fractures.

title: Mischaracterization of Mani Shankar Aiyar's 'Mughal' Remark
description: Modi claimed in a rally that Mani Shankar Aiyar had compared the internal democracy of the Congress party to the dynastic succession of Mughal rulers. Verification of the footage showed Aiyar was explicitly making a contrast, arguing that Congress elections were democratic unlike the automatic succession of the Mughals.

title: Claim on the National Detention Centers and NRC
description: During a rally at Ramlila Maidan in December 2019, Modi stated that there were no detention centers operating anywhere in India and that the National Register of Citizens (NRC) had never been discussed by his cabinet. Critics and journalists quickly pointed out that detention centers were already documented as functional in Assam, and multiple statements from his own Home Minister in Parliament contradicted the claim regarding NRC discussions.

title: Denial of Using Minority Rhetoric in Speeches
description: In a 2024 television interview, Modi asserted that he has never engaged in Hindu-Muslim political rhetoric or targeted minorities in his public addresses. Fact-checkers compiled dozens of archival speech transcripts from the 2024 campaign trail demonstrating direct rhetorical references to communities.

title: Claim of Uttar Pradesh Ranking First in Crime Rate Data
description: In a comparative development speech, Modi used statistics to assert that Uttar Pradesh had the worst overall crime rate metrics in India. National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) data refuted this, demonstrating that on a per-capita basis, over 10 other Indian states held higher crime rates.
